verdicts.reason: Both candidates are practically the same image, so neither wins. Both share the same flaws: the RSVP CTA shrinks into a small pill in the same row as the three badges, which kills the hierarchy, and a stray dash (the leftover missing-asset placeholder) trails after them. The time/venue line is cut off from its date and stuck at the far right next to the logo, the left-column tagline and URL are tiny, and the can graphic is shrunk to a meaningless scrap. The only difference is that B sits the time/venue line a few pixels lower.
